points: The shuttle team adds devices with different screens and inputs.
Each screen must handle loading, current, stale and unavailable arrivals.
Each repair must preserve access, privacy and maintainability.
prompt: What must the team now coordinate repeatedly? Would faster phones remove that work?

caption: A turnstile makes state and events visible. Follow one event at a time.

images.title: Turnstile state machine colored.svg
images.author: Chetvorno
images.alt: Two states, Locked and Unlocked. Coin unlocks Locked; Push locks Unlocked. Push at Locked and Coin at Unlocked leave the state unchanged.
